pages.title: Summonable Helper
pages.text: Right-click to summon a doll in the direction you are looking, up to 2 blocks away. You can have 8 active at once.

Every doll keeps its own health, name, dye color, and combat equipment, with the item's durability bar showing its health. Right-click the doll in your inventory to open its loadout; if a doll reaches zero health it breaks and cannot be summoned again until you repair it in an anvil with wool.
